summary.title: Show non‑main build warning at startup
changes: Shows a startup warning when the app was built from any branch other than main.
The warning appears once per launch and is only counted after you dismiss it.
The popup is suppressed while the app is loading and during onboarding so it won’t interrupt setup.
The alert offers an “I’m a Tester” dismiss button and a “How to Return to Main” link to documentation.
Update and critical-update alerts are no longer counted as shown if they couldn’t be presented, so they won’t be lost/”.
